data.title: Witness summons from Amtsgericht Musterquedlin
data.summary: The Amtsgericht Musterquedlin summons Uwe Beispielharz to testify as a witness in the civil case Beispielharz Dachbau GmbH vs. Marion Kessler regarding payment for work (Werklohn). The hearing is scheduled for Wednesday, 13 January 2027 at 09:00 in Saal 104.
data.explanation: A court has summoned you as a witness, not as a party, to a hearing about roofing work performed at Bodetal 6. You must appear at the stated date and time with this summons and an official photo ID. If you cannot attend, you need a sufficient excuse (e.g. illness) submitted to the court beforehand. Failing to appear without a valid excuse can result in you being charged the costs caused and a fine (Ordnungsgeld). You may be entitled to compensation for travel costs and lost earnings under the JVEG — ask the court's registry (Geschäftsstelle) how to claim this.

items.title: Testify as a witness in court
items.action: Attend the hearing as a witness and bring this summons along with an official photo ID.
items.consequence: If you fail to appear without sufficient excuse, the court may charge you for the costs caused and impose a fine (Ordnungsgeld) under § 380 ZPO.
